name: The Pebbles Inside
method: Installed built-in image generator supplied the motif; Node built-ins removed white in memory and composited pigment only in vacant rock. Generated motif overwritten by final wall.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a pigment motif to add to an existing prehistoric cave painting. Generate only an isolated small horizontal ochre bowl holding three uneven red ochre pebbles, with one curved charcoal arc above it like a shelter. Flat hand-drawn prehistoric earth pigment marks made by burnt stick and thumb, broken worn edges, minimal shapes. Pure clean white background, no rock background, no shading, no photographic texture, no 3D. Only red ochre, yellow ochre, charcoal black. Place motif centrally with wide white margin on all sides. No letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, border, frame, people, frogs or hands. This motif represents looking inside the enclosing transaction receipt to check three token transfers.

visual_review.limitations: Local visual review only. Inherited photographic-looking stone texture retained; added motif is flat earth pigment.
